pit_rule: QQQ O_t is public at the t open, C_t at the t close, so no lag beyond the trading-day clock: on_t=O_t/C_{t-1}-1 is known at the t open; a postponed fill at the open of e+1 uses only O_{e+1}. Fixed lag 0 for prices, no ALFRED vintages needed (no macro series added). 2014-12-31 has no QQQ row -> on_t=0 (identical to v1, 'not covered'). Prices are vendor split-adjusted (as of 2026), not dividend-adjusted; the 2010-era QQQ split history was not verified against as-traded prices (check O_t/C_{t-1} for jumps only inside the engine parity step).
